measured_problem: With exact native attention, the existing decoder passes aggregate relative RMSE and averages 0.998514 cosine on 27 held-out records, but the recurring abstention record scores 0.878846. That record has 30.38% within-capability unseen actions while the analytic decoder was fit from only 30 records per capability, despite 1000 already extracted records per capability being available.
proposed_method: Increase train-only analytic calibration from 30 to exactly 300 already extracted records per capability. Preserve the two locked validation identities at SHA-256 ranks 31 and 32; add ranks 33 through 302 to the original 30 training identities. Keep the native-attention oracle, 128-action cap, decoder, rank, ridge, routes, source, and gates unchanged.
material_differences: Tests the measured coverage bottleneck without extracting new teacher information.
Keeps validation identities fixed and excluded from all fitting.
Uses a single preregistered tenfold coverage point rather than a data-size sweep.
Writes no model and changes no deployed parameter or compute budget.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered expanded-calibration native-attention oracle. A pass establishes coefficient-decoder sufficiency at the fixed coverage budget and authorizes a realizable attention-path review; a miss closes existing-data calibration scaling without any data-size, context, decoder, route, rank, ridge, attention, layer, or source sweep.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no fit, realizable model, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
